name: A visitor's clock 10 minutes fast
environment: this machine: the park under wrangler dev on port 8797, the stand-in store on port 8791
hypothesis: A page whose clock runs 10 minutes fast comes into the hub with its pass, and draws the other owls walking as a page on the right time does, never jumping to where they are going.
blast_radius: Two scripted pages in the throwaway park, one after the other: one on the right time, one with its own clock set ahead.
abort_rule: Any steady-state check failing for more than 30 s during the experiment ends it and runs the rollback; the harness never leaves a fault injected.

observations.what: a page 10 minutes fast, into the hub by address
observations.value: online in 1163 ms, its clock 600 s ahead
observations.fix: take the pass as the park gives it, whatever the page clock says: refresh it by the time left as the park reckoned it

observations.what: the others' walks as the fast page draws them
observations.value: fast page: 160 looks at an owl mid-walk, 0 jumps in 50 looks; a page on the right time: 170 and 0 in 49
observations.fix: reckon the others' walks against the room server's clock (the edge transport's offset), never the page's own
